== Chapter 1: Autobots Turn ==

=== Mission 1: Wrong Place, Wrong Time ===
Part 1:

'''[[Wheeljack]]''': ''...and you turn it back down, and we're back in our correct timeline.''

'''[[Jetfire]]''': ''Are you sure the vectors on your device were calibrated? First scans indicate something has gone wrong. Terribly wrong.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''A little faith in my abilities as an inventor would be appreciated, I'm a leader in my field.''

'''Jetfire''': ''According to this, we have jumped several years backwards in a parallel timeline of [[New Quintessa]].''

'''Wheeljack''': ''...something may have broken.''

'''Jetfire''': ''Since this is technically a parallel dimension it also won't allow me to return to our origin point.'' 

'''Wheeljack''': ''...to be fair, that's a new feature and is still relatively impressive. But, I can see how that presents a unique problem.''

Part 2:

'''[[Grindor]]''': ''Looks like some fresh metal has arrived, ready for the Autobot scrapheap.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Oh great, I get to introduce the alternate timeline Decepticons to my knuckles all over again.''

'''Jetfire''': ''Alterations to timelines could have grave consequences, remember that.''

'''[[Mixmaster]]''': ''OH we'll make some grave alterations, like your face getting altered to a flaming wreck.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Does the timeline have laws regarding excessive force being used in self defense?''

'''Jetfire''': ''The timeline doesn't have laws, just a series of warnings. I'm starting to doubt these two held high priority in world events.''

Part 3:

'''Jetfire''': ''I'm reading intense bursts of Dark Energon, packets of a strange virus, and pulses of energy which are increasing at a geometric rate.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Yeah the little bars om my [[Chrono-Vector]] device are going up too. All red. Probably bad.''

'''Jetfire''': ''This has the signature of [[Megatronus]] all over it.''

'''[[Bonecrusher]]''': ''Who in the scrap is Megatronus? You mean Megatron?'' 

'''Wheeljack''': ''Eavesdropping isn't very polite big fella.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Where are my manners...PLEASE, stand there as I tear you apart Auto-Scum.''

=== Mission 2: Fight Fire With Fire ===
Part 1:

'''Jetfire''': ''Wheeljack, this is wrong. Everything is wrong. We have failed.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''We're just out of the loop is all, we'll get in touch with Optimus or Marissa and then--''

'''Jetfire''': '''''YOU HAVE DOOMED US!'''''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Control yourself! Think rationally!''

'''Jetfire''': ''I...I am sorry. Something came over me.''

Part 2:

'''[[Starscream]]''': ''Are my optics faulty? Have the fates brought me closure and delivered Skyfire to me?''

'''Jetfire''': ''[[Crossfire|This again]]...you are nothing if not predictable, Starscream. It's almost comforting.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''And he's goin' by Jetfire these days.''

'''Starscream''': ''Any name you choose, your function is the same: Destroy those who oppose the Decepticons.''

'''Jetfire''': '''''MY FUNCTION IS TO FURTHER SCIENCE! '''''

'''Starscream''': ''There's the fire I've been waiting for.''

Part 3:

'''Wheeljack''': ''Sorry to cut the reunion short, but if Megatronus isn't here yet there may be time to warn the others!''

'''Jetfire''': '''''I DON'T TAKE ORDERS FROM YOU!'''''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Seems like an over-reaction. You feeling okay, bud?''

'''Jetfire''': '''''YOU CLAIM TO BE A BOT OF SCIENCE! YOU ARE AND OBSCENE MOCKERY!'''''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Starting to get hurt feelings, I'd think real hard about what you're saying.''

'''Jetfire''': '''''THE TIME FOR THINKING IS PAST! STARSCREAM WAS RIGHT! I CRAVE ONLY...DESTRUCTION!'''''

=== Mission 3: Blast From The Past ===
Part 1:

'''Wheeljack''': ''Sorry for forcing an unexpected restart on you there...how are your circuits?''

'''Jetfire''': ''All my circuits are...alert. The virus affecting my logic and aggression seems to be cleared.''

'''[[Blaster]]''': ''Wheeljack! Jetfire! I thought that was you squakin' on my speakers. You're a sight for sore signals''

'''Wheeljack''': ''So, this is hard to explain but we're actually--''

'''Blaster''': ''From a timeline that runs alongside but slightly ahead of this timeline, and Megatronus might be coming.''

'''Jetfire''': ''You've been listening to us this whole time?''

'''Blaster''': ''Most of the time, I flip stations.''

Part 2:

'''Blaster''': ''Dark Energon pulses and viruses have been affecting Autobots. Making them extra unpleasent.''

'''Jetfire''': ''Are we the only recent arrivals? Any other new Sparks detected? Megatronus perhaps?''

'''Blaster''': ''Oh if you're looking for trouble, head for the Forge. From what I hear Shockwave is sparking up a storm!''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Sounds like ultimate doom and evil waits ahead of us...let's get a move on then.''

'''Blaster''': ''We'll need reinforcements, luckily I think some is on the way.''

'''[[Grimlock]]''': '''''GRAAAAAH! ME GRIMLOCK HEAD HURT! CRUSH ALL!'''''

'''Jetfire''': ''...that is consistent to the type of luck we've been attracting.''

Part 3:

'''Wheeljack''': ''We need to get a signal out to Prime, or the Commander, or Marissa.''

'''Blaster''': ''I've tried all signals, somethinfg is blockin' my talkin'. I can receive signal but no transmissions getting out.''

'''[[Bumblebee (DOTM)]]''': '''''NO ONE IS GETTING OUT! NOT IN ONE PIECE AT LEAST!'''''

'''Jetfire''': ''Bumblebee...where is Prime?''

'''Bumblebee(DOTM)''': '''''WHO KNOWS! WHO CARES! A VOICE IN MY HEAD DEMANDS I END YOU!'''''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Let's try some percussive maintenance with Bee.''

'''Jetfire''': ''Yes, I'm certain that after a reboot Bumblebee will be infinitely better.''

=== Mission 4: Mixed Messages ===
Part 1: 

'''Wheeljack''': ''We've got to do something...we need reinforcements. I'm open to all options.''

'''Blaster''': ''There's something I wanted to try, hold on. All signal open do you copy?''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Are you pulling in more Autobots? Care to share with the class Blaster?''

'''Blaster''': ''Come on now, don't play dumb. I know you're picking up the meanin' of my readin'.''

'''Jetfire''': ''He's not playing dumb, he's just like this.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''HEY! It's part of my charm.''

'''Blaster''': ''So then I must mean business or I wouldn't be talking would I?''

Part 2:

'''Blaster''': ''Listen, there's some Dark Energon goin' on and we have to work together.''

'''Jetfire''': ''That's what we've been saying. Wheeljack is he stuck on a chrono-loop?''

'''Blaster''': ''Clear your static you glitch-headed loyalist! You wanna' get scrapped?''

'''Wheeljack''': ''You're kind of worrying us Blaster. Are you even hearing us?''

'''Blaster''': ''We can talk about rulers when there's a planet left to plan on!''

'''Wheeljack''': ''That sounds like a no.''

Part 3:

'''Wheeljack''': ''Jetfire, I say we drag Blaster along and keep moving to the source of this radiation.'' 

'''Blaster''': ''The Forge! There's dark doings being done and we mean to stop it.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''That was dangerously close to a response that makes sense.''

'''Blaster''': ''That's what our time-hoppin' helpers have told us! That's why I'm talking to you!''

'''Jetfire''': ''Blaster! I demand to know who you're communicating with!''

'''Blaster''': ''Ruler Megatron! We'll see about that.''

'''Jetfire''': ''I've heard enough, he must be reacting to the virus in a unique fashion. Let's shut him down.''

'''Blaster''': ''Wait! NO! What are you doing?!''

=== Mission 5: Herald Of Destruction ===
Part 1:

'''Jetfire''': ''We must press on to the Forge, it is obvious that the disturbances are increasing.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''You have it on a map? Because all my signals are scrambled.''

'''Jetfire''': ''From what I have gathered thus far, as we get closer we will encounter more corrupted Autobots.''

'''[[Optimus Prime (MV1)]]''': '''''STAND DOWN OR BE DESTROYED!'''''

'''Wheeljack''': ''I'm simultaneously deeply disappointed you're right, and glad we're on the correct path.''

'''Jetfire''': ''Yes, I too feel complex emotions.''

Part 2:

'''Wheeljack''': ''Tough fight, but I think Optimus went easy on us.''

'''Jetfire''': ''It is possible he still had enough of his true self functioning to avoid removing our heads from our torsos.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Is that...a thing he's prone to do?''

'''Jetfire''': ''It's not unprecedented. I think we're at the edge of the disturbance.''

'''[[Jazz]]''': '''''THE VOICES! THEY SCREAM! THEY SAY TO END ALL WHO ENTER!'''''

'''Wheeljack''': ''...yeah probably pretty close.''

Part 3:

'''Jetfire''': ''We have arrived. Prepare for anything.''

'''[[Shockwave]]''': ''Be gone! He is nearly here! I have heard him in my head, I have prepared all! We shall return to Cybertron as gods!''

'''Jetfire''': ''If you're referring to Megatronus he's not big on sharing power.''

'''Shockwave''': ''I do not need his power shared, I merely need to ride in the wake of his destruction and rule over what is still standing.'' 

'''Wheeljack''': ''King Scrap of Junk-Mountain, it's a title that suits you.''

'''Shockwave''': ''The Forge has been tuned to your Chrono-Errors. It brings him! IT IS GLORIOUS!''

'''Jetfire''': ''Chrono-Errors? Shut it down, Wheeljack! Shut it down now!''

=== Mission 6: Dark Arrival ===
Part 1:

'''Shockwave''': ''You may have won a battle...but I shall still win this war. HE HAS ARRIVED!''

'''[[Megatronus]]''': ''Through time, space, and reality...I have to come to claim what is mine!''

'''Jetfire''': ''We are prepared for you this time.''

'''Megatronus''': ''No! You cannot fathom the lengths I have gone to reach this moment.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Well if you want to tell us, we're willing to listen...as I power-up this very large laser.''

Part 2: 

'''Megatronus''': ''Your rips in time allowed me to absorb power and knowledge of the Titan, then I traveled back to when it still slumbered...''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Oh, he's actually monologuing. I didn't think he'd take that option.''

'''Jetfire''': ''Wheeljack he's toying with us, he's charging up for an attack.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''He hijacks our time-travel, he's using my dirty fighting idea...Think for yourself Mega-copy-and-paster!''

'''Megatronus''': ''Allow me to demonstrate a mere sample of what I have planned for your kind.''

Part 3:

'''Wheeljack''': ''He's not going down, I'm open to new plans...''

'''Jetfire''': ''We hold. We delay. We fight until our sparks extinguish. We don't let him leave this Forge.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''...they better build some big statues of us for this. Chrome plated, Light up features.''

'''Megatronus''': ''There won't be anyone left to mourn you.'' 

'''Jetfire''': ''Enough talk, let's get down to business.''

== Chapter 2: Decepticons Burn ==

=== Mission 1: Fuel ===
Part 1:

'''[[Soundwave]]''': ''Decepticon Bonecrusher. You must follow me to assist with mission and signal tracking. Minesweeping form has tactical advantage.''

[[Bonecrusher|'''Bonecrusher''']]: Is this about those [[Wheeljack|new]] [[Jetfire|Autobots]] I just fought?

'''Soundwave''': ''Negative. New mission. Track and report. You are best utilized as front-line fodder in case of surprise attack.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Front of the line pass ey? Sounds like a promotion.''

'''Soundwave''': ''...Subspace interference from Maximal forces is detected. [[Shockwave]] is utilizing the Forge. Communication a priority. We must eliminate their signals.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Crush 'em all?''

'''Soundwave''''': Affirmative.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''We're singing the same tune.''

Part 2:

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Hey, since you're a sound expert I have a question for you...what's that noise we make?''

'''Soundwave''': ''Question is flawed. Many noises created at all times by all Bots. Signals always overwhelming.'' 

'''Bonecrusher''': ''The changin' noise. When we go from one thing to another. The "CHOKE-CHALK-CHEEK-CHOOSE" noise.''

'''Soundwave''': ''...The emission "TSCHE-CHU-CHRR-CHU-TSCHE" is an Energon tracking signal sent during the quantum-shift of our atoms' position and purpose.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Oh. Swell. I just like it is all...Can't make it without converting. CHUNK-CHEESE-TICK-TOCK. See? Not the same.''

'''Soundwave''': ''This conversation has been unpleasant. Continue to next post to shut down Maximal presence.''

<nowiki> </nowiki>Part 3:

'''[[Cheetor]]''': ''Hey! What's the big idea just sneaking up on folks and attacking? Buncha' Decepti-cowards?''

'''Soundwave''': ''Strange signal detected. Lives in balance. Maximal signal interfering. Solution: No Maximals.''

'''Cheetor''': ''You ever think about asking nicely?''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Decepticons don't ASK for results, we just GET results. Ain't that right Soundblaster?'' 

'''Soundwave''': '''''WAVE! SOUNDWAVE! SOUNDWAVE SUPERIOR!'''''

'''Cheetor''': ''Yeah, great teamwork. Lets see how you hold together after I get my claws into you!''

=== Mission 2: Fire ===
Part 1:

'''Soundwave''': ''Incoming urgent transmission...''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Ah, no Maximals and MAXIMUM signal. We're good at this.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Interference, signal unclear. Source unknown.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Sounds spooky, what are they saying?'' 

'''Soundwave''': ''What is the purpose of this? Subspace communication opens chance for espionage.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Are you...talking to me?'' 

'''Soundwave''': ''Make your intent clear or the signal and your Spark will be terminated.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''HEY! You best watch yourself bud.''

Part 2:

'''[[Scorponok]]''': ''I saw you're kicking Maximal tail, what's a guy gotta' do to join up?'' 

'''Soundwave''': ''Negative, additional assistance from inferior forces would only guarantee Decepticon demise.''

'''Scorponok''': ''No vote of confidence from the blank-faced tape-flipper, huh?''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''He has been weird. Some signal he's talking to. Think he may have switched his stations.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Decepticons shall rule what is left.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Alright so he's still talking SOME sense.''

Part 3:

'''Soundwave''': ''Forces should be focused upon the Forge.''

'''Bonecruhser''': ''The Forge? Nothing good comes in or out of there.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Shockwave is bringing a Spark back from the beyond.''

'''Scorponok''': ''That sounds like a thing we should stop.''

'''Soundwave''': ''We shall combine forces, but ruler [[Megatron]] is the only rightful leader.'' 

''Autobot respond! Respond!''

'''Bonecrusher''': '''''YOU'VE BEEN TALKING TO AN AUTOBOT? THIS WHOLE TIME?'''''

'''Soundwave''': ''Lower weapons now or be destroyed.''

=== Mission 3: Desire ===
Part 1:

'''Soundwave''': ''INQUIRY: Why did you attack?''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''It's the Dark Energon thing. Bot goes funny and you hit 'em till you turn 'em off or knock some sense into 'em.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Miscalculation. No Dark Energon malfunction has occurred. Autobots sent to Forge in order to provide'' ''needed bodies for battle.''

'''Scorponok''': ''You're just teaming up so you can use them as living shields?'' 

'''Soundwave''': ''Autobot destruction will assist Decepticons. As they charge into battle we shall observe.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''I gotta say, you're heartless buddy. And that's coming from ME.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Affirmative. I posses no heart, nor needless emotional programming. Only function is logic and loyalty to Decepticon causes.''

''We continue. Signal for Megatron is ahead. You two walk in front.''

<nowiki> </nowiki>Part 2:

'''[[Megatron]]''': '''''GRAAAAAHHRRRHHGGH''''' 

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Your Megatron usually like that?''

'''Soundwave''': ''Negative. Infection of Dark Energon has corrupted his circuitry.''

'''Scorponok''': ''Yeah that's a shame, always hate to see it happen. Give me a call if a Dinosaur version of him shows up.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Negative. All plans require Megatron leadership. He must be assisted.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Well, we can TRY to knock him down I guess. But he's taking off at quite a clip.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Follow Megatron. Destroy all in path. Top priority is Megatron's safety.''

Part 3:

'''Megatron''': '''''STAY BACK! I WILL GRIND YOU ALL TO DUST!'''''

'''Soundwave''': ''Megatron. Regain senses. Urgent tasks necessitate your leadership.''

'''Megatron''': '''''MEGATRON OBEYS NO ONE!'''''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''I don't know if we got the firepower for this one.''

'''Soundwave''': ''We do not seek to destroy. Only to survive the resetting of Megatron's senses.''

'''Scorponok''': ''So best case scenario is that we survive long enough for Megatron to be aware we just tried to beat him up.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Affirmative.''

'''Scorponok''': ''What's the reverse of a sneak attack? Obvious attack? If I had the ability to make a better plan I'd advise against this. But...let's do the dumb one I guess.''

=== Mission 4: Burn ===
Part 1:

'''Soundwave''': ''Megatron systems rebooting. Preparing apologies for forced resetting.''

'''Megatron''': ''I am owed too many apologies for yours to suffice, Soundwave. Whoever is behind these indignities shall pay dearly.''

'''Scorponok''': ''Soundwave was organizing a team-up. The Autobots and us are all rushin' to the fjord. Where are the narrow inlets created by glaciers around here?''

'''Soundwave''': ''THE FORGE. Our destination is THE FORGE.''

'''Megatron''': ''At every turn, at every impasse...I am cursed by the pathetic processing power of my minions.''

'''Soundwave''': ''With respect Leader Megatron. We must hurry before all is lost.''

'''Megatron''': ''So long as vengeance lays before us. Lead on, Soundwave.''

Part 2:

'''Soundwave''': ''Shockwave is utilizing the Forge to awaken dark powers. Solution. Eliminate Shockwave. Destroy Forge.''

'''Megatron''': ''An admirable plan, but we shall require more troops.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Autobots have been sent ahead.''

'''Megatron''': ''Fuel for the fire, they'll serve only to distract or delay the inevitable. We must gather forces while we can.''

'''[[Thundercracker]]''': ''Well if you're looking for someone who can lay down some heavy fire, Maybe I can be bribed into assisting.''

'''Scorponok''': ''Hey! Blue Starscream is here!''

'''Thundercracker''': '''''EXCUSE ME?!'''''

Part 3:

'''Megatron''': ''Thundercracker, you shall obey my commands and assist our mission.''

'''Thundercracker''': ''Nope! No way, I ain't joining in until we punish the guy with a bee for a fist!''

'''Scorponok''': ''It's not really a fist so much as a clamp. Bees just kind of fire out of it. Never stopped to ask why to be'' honest.

'''Thundercracker''': ''He's too dumb to even know I hate him! You call this a team?''

'''Soundwave''': ''Decepticons superior together. Cease bickering. Fall in line.''

'''Thundercracker''': ''I rule the skies! I never fall! Time to show you that!''

=== Mission 5: Face ===
Part 1:

'''Scorponok''': ''There ya' go. The Dark Energon making you be a jerk is probably gone now.''

'''Thundercracker''': ''Dark Energon? What? Sure why not. Ugh, my achin' fuselage.''

'''Megatron''': ''Where are your compatriots? As much as saying these words twist my Spark...[[Starscream]] and Skywarp could be of assistance.''

'''Thundercracker''': ''I ain't seen Skywarp in ages. But I think I saw Starscream going nutty somewhere around here. Shame it ain't all of us. It's like a tricycle missing a wheel.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''So...a bicycle?''

'''Thundercracker''': ''I don't know you. But I don't like you.''

Part 2:

'''Soundwave''': ''Dark Energon emissions increasing rapidly. Forge may be active.''

'''[[Starscream]]''': '''''PITIFUL PEASANTS. HAVE YOU COME TO SUFFER AT THE HANDS OF LORD STARSCREAM?'''''

'''Thundercracker''': ''So this team you're trying to build up on your way to the Forge, Boss? Feel like it's going pretty well so far?''

'''Megatron''': ''As always, I work with what the universe provides. A feral Starscream could at least prove to function as a distraction.''

'''Starscream''': '''''MEGAAAATROOOOONNN! I SHALL RULE THE DECEPTICONS!'''''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''That voice. I think some of my glass parts just cracked.''

Part 3: 

'''Megatron''': ''Starscream, enough of this nonsense. Kisten to your leader!''

'''Starscream''': '''''I AM LISTENING! TO [[Galvatron|GALVATRON]] AND [[Cyclonus|CYCLONUS]]! THEY PROMISE POWER! THEY COMMAND!'''''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''Those the Unicron guys? I don't trust anything that came out of that weird planet hole of his.''

'''Megatron''': ''Yes. With the Forge activating it is possible they look to impress their old master. They must be using Dark Energon to gather their forces.''

'''Starscream''': '''''THEY SUMMON YOU! YOU HAVE HEARD THE CALL!'''''

'''Megatron''':''''' NOBODY SUMMONS MEGATRON!'''''

=== Mission 6: Upon The Chrome ===
Start Point:

'''Starscream''': ''My head. What happened? All I remember is shouting.''

'''Scorponok''': ''Cyclonus and Galvatron got up in your hardware and used you like a puppet. Then we punched you till you stopped.''

'''Megatron''': ''You're disloyal, dishonest, and a disappointment. However, I think this latest failure may spur you on to action, Starscream.''

'''Starscream''': ''No one can motivate their troops like you can, dearest Megatron. I do however crave revenge so it seems our goals are aligned.''

'''Thundercracker''': ''Nothing like getting the and back together, now we can all march into the mouth of certain death like a family.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Two paths lay ahead. Both lead to possible destruction. A choice must be made.''

Left path: 

'''[[Cyclonus]]''': ''This pathetic gathering looks to stop the arrival of Lord Megatronus?''

'''Megatron''': ''Megatronus? He's coming here?''

'''Cyclonus''': ''Not coming, he has arrived! The Autobots are already in the Forge being torn to shreds.''

'''Bonecrusher''': ''So this guy shows up then gets to have all the fun AND locks us out of the show?! What kinda Decepticon is he?''

'''Cyclonus''': ''He is the beginning of the end for this planet. Galvatron and I welcome him with open arms.''

'''Megatron''': ''Yes. GOOD. Open your arms. It gives me a chance to rip out that traitorous heart of yours!''

Right path:

'''[[Galvatron]]''': ''You fight fate like a child trying to hold back a tide. It is coming. It is here. Embrace it.''

'''Megatron''': ''Megatron alone controls his fate. You have become accustomed to serving under the heel of another, Galvatron. Perhaps my boot should have its turn.''

'''Scorponok''': ''YEAH! MESS UP THAT PURPLE PRETENDER!''

'''Galvatron''': ''Fools and mindless beasts. I look forward to seeing the pained expressions on your functionless bodies once Megatronus has defeated you.''

'''Soundwave''': ''Signals from Autobots indicate they are already battling Megatronus.''

'''Galvatron''': ''Yes, soon I shall witness the fall of the Autobots AND of the pathetic remnants of the Decepticons.''

'''Megatron''': ''You shall see nothing more than your own circuits scattered across the abyss of space. DECEPTICONS ATTACK!''

End point:

'''[[Wheeljack]]''': ''He's just not shutting down Jetfire. What sweet science you want me to teach him next?''

'''[[Jetfire]]''': ''Megatronus is near defeated...we must just rally for another attack.''

'''Thundercracker''': ''SKYFIRE! Well it is a big day for reunions''.

'''Jetfire''': ''Jetfire, thank you...you are actually a welcome sight old friend.''

'''[[Megatronus]]''': '''''YOU HAVE ONLY COME TOGETHER TO DIE NEXT TO EACH OTHER.'''''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Right, sorry...almost forgot. You guys want to beat up a wanna-be god? Figure you can have a turn.''

'''Megatron''': ''I shall prove that only I am fit to rule this world!''

'''Megatronus''': ''I may be damaged, but this form shall soon mean nothing to me. Dare to strike me down and I shall become more powerful than you could possibly imagine!''

== Chapter 3: Hit The Road ==

=== Mission 1: Haste ===
Part 1: 

'''[[Wheeljack]]''': [[Megatronus|''Megatronus'']]'' is shut down, [[Galvatron]] and [[Cyclonus]] sent packing...Time to go home?''

'''[[Jetfire]]''': ''This is not a fantasy tale, we weren't just waiting for an excuse to click our heels and head back. We are trapped between realities, Wheeljack.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''I was hoping this was one of those "happily ever after" stories that wrapped up cleanly.''

'''[[Nemesis Prime]]''': ''Nothing is clean about you. You spread filth across timelines and spoil reality itself.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Just popping over to the universe next-door to say hi, Nemesis?''

'''Nemesis Prime''': ''I have split time, ruptured reality, and traversed dimensions to come and punish you.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''...that is a LOT of effort. Sounds like SOMEONE has a crush.''

Part 2: 

'''Nemesis Prime''': ''You have tangled realities and formed a knot that must be eliminated. Destruction is the only logical path.'' 

'''Jetfire''': ''You speak of logic? Knots can be undone, they need not be cut off. We can help to set things right!''

'''Nemesis Prime''': ''No, I shall remove your chrono-travel abilities and once you are stranded in time and space you shall be destroyed.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''You and what army, big dark and ugly? You know I've seen some slime in my time but YOU take the cake.''

'''Jetfire''': ''Don't...mock...the reality bending destroyer.''

'''Nemesis Prime''': ''I have forces working alongside me. Though they may not yet know it. I withdraw to the shadows now to watch you suffer.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Not if I have anything to say about...and he's gone. Guess I didn't have a say.''

Part 3:

'''[[Hound]]''': ''H-hey there fellas. N-n-not feeling too good. Something's burning me up.'' 

'''Wheeljack''': ''I don't suppose a negatively shaded Prime has been whispering in your ear?''

'''Hound''': ''Matter of fact o-one did stop b-b-by. Stop. By. stop. STOP.''

'''Jetfire''': ''Your vocal systems appear faulty, Hound. Run diagnostics before corruption takes hold.''

'''Hound''': '''''HAND OVER THE CHRONO-DEVICE AND SUBMIT TO YOUR DOOM.'''''

'''Wheeljack''': ''Oh good, the stutter is gone. One problem down and SO MANY MORE brought up!''

== Chapter 1: Autobots Turn ==

=== Mission 1: Wrong Place, Wrong Time ===
Part 1:

'''[[Wheeljack]]''': ''...and you turn it back down, and we're back in our correct timeline.''

'''[[Jetfire]]''': ''Are you sure the vectors on your device were calibrated? First scans indicate something has gone wrong. Terribly wrong.''

'''Wheeljack''': ''A little faith in my abilities as an inventor would be appreciated, I'm a leader in my field.''

'''Jetfire''': ''According to this, we have jumped several years backwards in a parallel timeline of [[New Quintessa]].''
